This develops accepted Opus OD-04/06/07/09 follow-ups as **one gameplay batch in two sequential author steps**: [M1-PLAY-CORE](M1-PLAY-CORE.md) implements rules, economy and strict save compatibility; [M1-PLAY-PRESENTATION](M1-PLAY-PRESENTATION.md) follows from a reconciled committed source with controls, canon-aware copy, wildlife cues and final ordinary-play evidence. Sol6.1/max authors both steps in isolated tasks; root owns integration. No concurrent consumer authoring against uncommitted interfaces. The intended loop is a clue, a preparation choice, a habitat-specific expedition, a readable encounter, useful cargo, and an improvement the player can use on the next trip. Existing earned New→C01–C04→Dart→Canopy→return evidence is the comparison route; its25 collections/31 transfers are one observed route, not an optimum.
